        StatusLabel.Text = string.char(75,101,121,32,97,99,99,101,112,116,101,100,33,32,76,111,97,100,105,110,103,46,46,46)
        SubmitBtn.Active = false
        task.wait(1)
        ScreenGui:Destroy()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(SCRIPT_URL))()
    else
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        StatusLabel.Text = string.char(73,110,118,97,108,105,100,32,107,101,121,46,32,84,114,121,32,97,103,97,105,110,46)
        InputBox.Text = string.char(32):rep(0)
    end
end
